The United States is the richest country in the world. Meanwhile, millions of Americans are uninsured, underinsured, or drowning in medical debt.

posts.text:
A study found that there was a dramatic spike in cancer diagnoses when Americans hit age 65. Why? Because they finally qualified for Medicare and could afford to see a doctor. 

People should be able to go to the doctor when they need to, not when they age into coverage. It’s time for Medicare for All.

posts.text:
I went to immigration court in Seattle to observe the kids' docket. These kids are expected to represent themselves in court.

To expect a child, clutching a stuffed animal, to argue against a seasoned attorney is ridiculous. We can and should be providing children with legal counsel.
